description: For a betslip the customer showed you (screenshot, paste or their words): send each leg as printed (event, selection, market, period, line, odds; unknown fields null). Returns, per leg, match.status matched | event_only | ambiguous | unmatched with the eventId, the selection marketId and the exact catalog market when matched, using the same search the app uses, plus defaultJurisdiction (the account’s connected book state, else US). Nothing is saved, graded or placed; build the ticket from matched legs and save it with the tracked-slip tools.
name: match_ticket_legs
title: Match ticket legs to games
